title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Names Mark Vondrak as Director of Leasing for Houston Office
summary: Vondrak Oversees Southwest and Midwest Region InvenTrust Properties Corp. announced it has named Mark Vondrak as the Director of Leasing in its Houston office. Mr. Vondrak, a 25-year veteran of the real estate industry, oversees all retail leasing activities and assists in market expansion efforts for the South Texas, Louisiana, and Midwest portions of the companys national portfolio. This Smart News Release features multimedia. View the full release here: http://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20150605005328/en/ (Photo: Business Wire) Houston is a strategic market for us, InvenTrust Properties Executive Vice President of Portfolio Management David F. Collins said. Were targeting high growth markets and establishing a regional presence in these areas to offer retailers dedicated local expertise. Mark is a seasoned real estate professional with tremendous experience throughout Texas. Weve been fortunate to have him on the InvenTrust team
